emojis.summary: Two of the seven villagers who entered the narrow tunnels in search for gold on 20 May are still missing.

emojis.title: What to Know About the Ebola Outbreak
emojis.summary: Aid agencies are racing to help underequipped health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo. More than 245 people are now suspected to have died from the virus.

emojis.summary: The technology, developed under the Aukus military pact, is aimed at protecting undersea cables and boosting naval defence.

emojis.title: Ye and Travis Scott Concerts Canceled in Italy Over Security Fears
emojis.summary: The events were canceled “to ensure public order and safety,” the authorities said. Jewish leaders had objected to the concert by Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, who has a history of antisemitic remarks.
